_purpose: Working-sample filings that state whether booked claims provisions carry a management margin above the actuarial best estimate (the review of 2 October 2026, M-3; decision D3-2 of 4 October 2026). Each entry is a hit of the review's pattern scan (plan/review-2026-10-02/scratch/R1/margin_scan.py in the manuscript repository, pattern below) over the text layer of the 674 working-sample PDFs, classified by reading its quote: held (a margin is carried), conditional ('a margin may be applied'), contradicting ('no margin ...'), or unclear. src/check_margin_sensitivity.py reads it. The scan read PDFs only: the 2024 filings published only as HTML were not read, so every count here is a lower bound for 2024 until the PC rescans those filings with the same pattern and completes this file. A quote is cut to its sentence where the scan's snippet holds the whole sentence; otherwise the snippet is kept and marked pc_reread, for the PC to re-read from the filing, as is any snippet with a damaged character or a garbled text layer.
_pattern: (margin[^.]{0,120}best estimate|best estimate[^.]{0,120}margin|management margin|margin (?:over|above|in excess of) (?:the )?(?:actuarial )?(?:best estimate|actuarial))
_source: plan/review-2026-10-02/scratch/R1/margin_scan.json (manuscript repository), 132 hits in 674 filings scanned, 0 errors
_classified: stage 3 of the fix cycle, 4 October 2026: every quote read; the PC checks the marked ones
